podcast.body: This was Christine's self-titled solo album, one of only three solo LPs she would record in her lifetime, released after she had gained fame as a member of Chicken Shack. The album showcased her songwriting and vocals, and it included a cover of a Danny Kirwan song, "When You Say," on which Kirwan himself played guitar. "The self-titled Christine Perfect LP showcased her songwriting and her vocals."

podcast.body: This album was Christine McVie's first solo record, released under her maiden name, pre-dating the solo efforts of her Fleetwood Mac bandmates. "Ironic, as she'd been the first to release a solo LP way back in 1970."
